questions.prompt: Which explanation establishes that AC must be a diameter?
choices: Every side of an inscribed right triangle is a diameter.
Any chord joining two points on a circle must pass through the center.
The intercepted arc measures 90°, so AC is a diameter.
The 90° inscribed angle intercepts a 180° arc, so AC is the chord joining the endpoints of a semicircle.
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle measures half its intercepted arc. The arc from A to C opposite B measures 2(90°) = 180°. Its endpoints are opposite ends of a diameter.
